3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: From anywhere in the city of Montaklar, you could look high into the hills and see the ruins of Fortress Azaro.

4.speaker: Lucita Azaro
4.text: "How do you like the view, Your Majesty?"

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Expanded and fortified over the centuries, it had served as a stronghold for the city's inhabitants from the early years of the Rezenid Empire until its destruction in the War of Rizian Succession.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Today, the ruins served as a symbol of Montaklar's resilience - and that of its governing house. Perhaps that was why Lucita had invited me here for a tour and private talk.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: For safety's sake, a wooden walkway had been constructed over the crumbling remains of the parapets. Lucita and I walked along it until we came to the northwestern corner.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: From here, we could look down into the valley, where the provincial capital sprawled across the fast-flowing Alca river and up into the foothills of the mountains opposite us.

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "It's fine. I always preferred the ocean over mountains, myself."

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "Spectacular. Why did you bring me here, Duchess Azaro?"

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "I remember it well from my military days."

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "Imagine how this fortress must have looked a thousand years ago."

17.speaker: Lucita Azaro
17.text: "I've come here as a child, as an army recruit and as a duchess. It's always different, and always the same."

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: The fortress was closed off for our visit, but a crowd had gathered just outside its walls.

19.speaker: Lucita Azaro
19.text: "My province has been cut off from the ocean since we lost Pales. We've learned to make do with what we have."

20.speaker: Lucita Azaro
20.text: "It took years for the Azaro and Toras families to repair their bond. I hope our houses will remain harmonious through your reign."

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "Is that why you brought me here, Duchess Azaro?"

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "Nothing means more to me than keeping the favor of House Azaro."

24.speaker: Lucita Azaro
24.text: "I didn't agree with your decision to supercede my authority and transfer Central Police forces to the Duke of Iza."

25.speaker: Lucita Azaro
25.text: "It's great to hear you say that."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "You don't understand. Iza is at a tipping point. The city's fate could determine that of the country."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "House Toras takes care of its own. If I do grant special favors to my cousin, that's none of your business."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "My family comes first, Duchess. You have to respect that."

29.speaker: Lucita Azaro
29.text: "Not even the Markians could destroy this place, you know. Only when Rizia's noble families turned against each other did it finally fall."

30.speaker: Lucita Azaro
30.text: "For one, it's been too long since you visited this province. My constituents were starting to wonder if their king still cared about them."

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: She paused and turned to face me.

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: She gestured to the stone wall behind us. A metal ladder led to the top of a small watchtower, now the fortress' highest surviving structure.

34.speaker: Narrator
34.text: Lucita scaled it in a matter of seconds.

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "I'll stay down here for now. What can you see?"

37.speaker: Lucita Azaro
37.text: "Don't you remember? Camp Domus is just downhill from here."

41.speaker: Lucita Azaro
41.text: "Camp Domus is just downhill from here."

42.speaker: Narrator
42.text: From below, I heard the sound of a snare drum beating out a complex rhythm, followed by that of boots hitting the ground in unison.

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: From what I knew was the main square, I heard the sound of a snare drum beating out a complex rhythm, followed by that of boots hitting the ground in unison.

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: The drumbeat dictated the platoon formation. It was a system from ancient days, modernized by Lucita's ancestor Domus Azaro.

45.speaker: Lucita Azaro
45.text: "Long, short, short, long... that's an inverted wedge."

46.speaker: Lucita Azaro
46.text: "Long, short, short, long... that's an inverted wedge, right?"

47.speaker: Lucita Azaro
47.text: "These are new recruits. They'll learn fast."

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: From this side, we could see Camp Domus, the country's largest military training facility. It stretched far into the distance, with hundreds of barracks clustered around grounds that simulated all types of terrain.

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: We looked down onto the main square. A platoon of some 50 soldiers -- mostly men, but a few women as well -- was preparing for an exercise.

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: A drummer to the side of the square beat out a complex rhythm on a snare.

56.speaker: Narrator
56.text: A drummer to the side of the square beat out a complex rhythm on a snare.

57.speaker: Lucita Azaro
57.text: "Long, short, short, long... that's an inverted wedge, right?"

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: The soldiers snapped into a V-shaped formation, narrow at the back and widening towards the front.

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "I can't believe they're still using that system."

61.speaker: Lucita Azaro
61.text: "Long, short, short, long... that's an inverted wedge."

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: The soldiers snapped into a V-shaped formation, narrow at the back and widening towards the front.

65.speaker: Player_Romus
65.text: "The woman on the right side was a little slow."

66.speaker: Lucita Azaro
66.text: "Comms can get jammed, orders misunderstood. But rhythm, you feel in your bones."

67.speaker: Lucita Azaro
67.text: "Comms can get jammed, orders misunderstood. But rhythm, you feel in your bones."

69.speaker: Lucita Azaro
69.text: "It's an ancient system from the province. My ancestor Domus Azaro turned it into a proper code."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "I can't believe they're still using that system."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "Sounds like one of them is just a little bit out of step."

73.speaker: Lucita Azaro
73.text: "Comms can get jammed, orders miscommunicated. But rhythm, you feel in your bones."

74.speaker: Lucita Azaro
74.text: "At least 50. And five women, from the looks of it."

76.speaker: Lucita Azaro
76.text: "Still the best-trained soldiers in South Merkopa."

78.speaker: Narrator
78.text: She brushed herself off. I saw steel in her eyes.

80.speaker: Lucita Azaro
80.text: "It's an ancient system from the province. My ancestor Domus Azaro turned it into a proper code."

82.speaker: Narrator
82.text: Another rhythm came from the drum: two rimshots followed by a rapid roll.

84.speaker: Narrator
84.text: Almost unconsciously, she started moving along with the soldiers. But as she put her left foot down, the section of wall beneath it suddenly gave way.

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: She began falling backwards towards me.

91.speaker: Narrator
91.text: She brushed herself off and turned to face me. I saw steel in her eyes.

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: As she landed in my arms, my weak leg buckled underneath me. I hit the ground with her on top of me.

98.speaker: Lucita Azaro
98.text: "I'm fine. We're both fine. But who the hell let that happen?"

99.speaker: Lucita Azaro
99.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. It seems old habits die hard."

100.speaker: Lucita Azaro
100.text: "It's nearly four. Let me show you something."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "I would follow you, but my bum leg won't allow it."

105.speaker: Lucita Azaro
105.text: "I'm afraid I forgot about that, Your Majesty. You always seem so limber."

106.speaker: Lucita Azaro
106.text: "You're familiar with the sight, anyway. Camp Domus is just downhill from here."

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: She was right. I remembered exactly how the camp looked -- a vast training ground simulating all types of terrain, surrounded by hundreds of barracks.

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: Lucita avoided my gaze as we left the fortress.

111.speaker: Narrator
111.text: Another rhythm came from the drum: two rimshots followed by a rapid roll.

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: Almost unconsciously, she started moving along with the soldiers. But as she put her left foot down, the section of wall beneath it suddenly gave way.

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: She looked up at me in surprise, breathing heavily.

120.speaker: Lucita Azaro
120.text: "It seems old habits die hard. Thank you, Your Majesty."

121.speaker: Lucita Azaro
121.text: "Now, who the hell let that happen?"

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: Lucita hurriedly stepped away from me, brushed herself off and turned to the guards.

123.speaker: Narrator
123.text: She swiftly turned her back on me and told the guards it was time to leave.

124.speaker: Narrator
124.text: She swiftly climbed down and told the guards it was time to leave.

127.speaker: Narrator
127.text: We waved down to them, then turned away, following the walkway towards the former armory. Our aides and guards stayed a respectable distance behind.

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "I don't see why that wouldn't be the case. You and your relatives have sworn fealty to the crown, have they not?"

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "As long as you keep your family in line, they will."

131.speaker: Lucita Azaro
131.text: "Your father and mine were close, Your Majesty. General Taddeus told me that he felt free to express his true opinions to the King, with no fear of repercussion."

132.speaker: Lucita Azaro
132.text: "I'd like it if you and I had a similar relationship."

133.speaker: Lucita Azaro
133.text: "You don't need to worry about my family's loyalty. I guess I'm referring specifically to the two of us."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "I want to have that relationship with all of my councilors, Duchess. Nobody should feel like they have to hold back their opinions."

135.speaker: Player_Romus
135.text: "And what makes you think you deserve that? You've barely been on the council for a year."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "How can we when we barely even know each other?"

138.speaker: Narrator
138.text: She trained her eyes on a lizard that was crawling up the wall next to us.

139.speaker: Lucita Azaro
139.text: "You have my permission, then. Ask me anything about myself."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "Well... why aren't you married? As an Azaro, you should've been paired off the day you came of age."

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "Let's drop the small talk. You brought me here today because you want something."
141.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_LucitaPersonalQs_Hobbies"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_LucitaPersonalQs_Marriage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_LucitaPersonalQs_Career"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_Montaklar_LucitaSpeaksMind"] == false)

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "Let's see. Do you have any hobbies?"

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "Why did you follow in the Azaro family's footsteps? You could've chosen your own path in life."

144.speaker: Lucita Azaro
144.text: "My path was chosen for me after my uncle was killed in the uprising."

145.speaker: Lucita Azaro
145.text: "Even as a young girl, I knew that marked a turning point. My noble blood didn't make me safe anymore."

147.speaker: Lucita Azaro
147.text: "They had a match chosen for me, of course. But my father allowed me to break off the engagement when I joined the military."

148.speaker: Lucita Azaro
148.text: "By the time I got out, I was considered too old to be of use in the marriage arena."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "Who's going to carry on the Azaro legacy, then?"

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "That's ridiculous. A woman like you should be swarmed with suitors."

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "So you've never known the touch of a man?"

152.speaker: Player_Romus
152.text: "You were what, 28? That's ancient for a woman."

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: She raised an eyebrow, then laughed lightly.

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: A wry smile formed on her face.

157.speaker: Lucita Azaro
157.text: "I'm not so pathetic as to base my self-worth on what men think of me. But thank you for the compliment."

158.speaker: Lucita Azaro
158.text: "Call me foolish. I chose my country over my womanly reputation."

160.speaker: Lucita Azaro
160.text: "My younger sister is poised to bring us an heir sooner or later. If not her, then surely one of our cousins."

161.speaker: Lucita Azaro
161.text: "Do you have any questions of a less... intimate nature?"

162.speaker: Lucita Azaro
162.text: "I've always enjoyed archery, when I've had the time for it."

163.speaker: Lucita Azaro
163.text: "And my father and I used to play chess together. We still do, when he has a lucid moment."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "Maybe you and I can play someday."

169.speaker: Lucita Azaro
169.text: "If you're prepared to lose, Your Majesty."

170.speaker: Narrator
170.text: She gave me a taunting look.

171.speaker: Lucita Azaro
171.text: "I do, mostly. I've let him win a few times since the stroke."

172.speaker: Lucita Azaro
172.text: "I beg to differ. If you can win at chess, you can win at war."

173.speaker: Lucita Azaro
173.text: "You *really* must not know me, Your Majesty."

178.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
178.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_LucitaPersonalQs_Hobbies"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_LucitaPersonalQs_Marriage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_LucitaPersonalQs_Career"] == true) == false

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "Those days are over. We don't have to live in fear of another uprising."

192.speaker: Player_Romus
192.text: "The real threat isn't from the commoners. It's from the foreign powers who want to destroy our way of life."

193.speaker: Player_Romus
193.text: "Your words ring true. I had the exact same thought after my kidnapping."

194.speaker: Lucita Azaro
194.text: "And you didn't feel the drive to do something about it? To armor yourself against such threats in the future?"

195.speaker: Lucita Azaro
195.text: "Whatever the source of the threat, it pays to be prepared for it. As a kingdom, and as an individual."

198.speaker: Narrator
198.text: She looked at me with flinty eyes.

200.speaker: Lucita Azaro
200.text: "I know. It would be exceedingly gracious of you to extend that level of trust to me."

205.speaker: Lucita Azaro
205.text: "My house and I had questions regarding your recent meeting in Sallabes."

206.speaker: Lucita Azaro
206.text: "Sources say you were quite deep in conversation with the House Sazon heir."

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "It's all strategic. Without the Sazons on my side, I won't be able to prevent another uprising."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "We were speaking of repairing the bond between our houses. As you yourself said, Rizia can only be strong if all of its royal families stand together."

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "We were guests in his province. Refusing to converse would've been a terrible breach of etiquette."

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "Did those sources fail to tell you I turned him away?"

214.speaker: Lucita Azaro
214.text: "That's what he led you to believe? His house would help you stop an uprising?"

215.speaker: Lucita Azaro
215.text: "You might as well use gasoline to put out a fire."

216.speaker: Lucita Azaro
216.text: "The Sazons were never a royal family. Just a group of merchants who fancied themselves higher than their true station."

217.speaker: Lucita Azaro
217.text: "You know the entire house is still suspected to have ties to Arcasia."

218.speaker: Lucita Azaro
218.text: "As terrible as what his family did to you?"

219.speaker: Lucita Azaro
219.text: "I had that impression. But I wanted to hear it from you."

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "I want to get closer to Arcasia. It's part of my diplomatic strategy."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "I don't know about Manus. He seems different."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "That isn't surprising. Arcasia has eyes and ears everywhere."

227.speaker: Lucita Azaro
227.text: "Don't trust the man around your daughter, is all I'm saying."

228.speaker: Lucita Azaro
228.text: "No matter what, Your Majesty, I wouldn't trust that man around your daughter."

229.speaker: Lucita Azaro
229.text: "All the more reason not to trust that man around your daughter."

230.speaker: Lucita Azaro
230.text: "Oh, I'm not discounting the threat of United Contana. But they don't have tentacles in the Rizian nobility. Yet."

231.speaker: Lucita Azaro
231.text: "They and their allies have spent the better part of this century trying to undermine us."

238.speaker: Lucita Azaro
238.text: "That's what he wants you to think. Keep in mind Arcasia and its allies have been endlessly inventive in their attempts to undermine us."

239.speaker: Lucita Azaro
239.text: "I would ask you to reconsider that. Put your faith in the West and their allies, and they'll abuse it every time."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "Thank you for your advice. Perhaps I'll require your assistance with this in the future."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "This is not a matter of national security. You needn't involve yourself in it."

242.speaker: Player_Romus
242.text: "My daughter is allowed to consort with whomever she wants. Surely you understand that as a modern woman."

243.speaker: Player_Romus
243.text: "I appreciate your concern. But I will deal with Mr. Sazon and his family on my own."

244.speaker: Lucita Azaro
244.text: "Isn't it, though? An agent of chaos attempting to get cozy with the royal family?"

245.speaker: Lucita Azaro
245.text: "As the woman in charge of this country's security, all I see is an agent of chaos attempting to get cozy with the royal family."

246.speaker: Lucita Azaro
246.text: "I'm just looking out for national security. As is my job."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "Well, I am nothing if not gracious. Tell me what's on your mind."

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "I cannot trust you if I don't know you. Tell me more about yourself."

250.speaker: Lucita Azaro
250.text: "I hope your curiosity has been satisfied."

254.speaker: Lucita Azaro
254.text: "Well, let me know if you do require my assistance."

255.speaker: Lucita Azaro
255.text: "I had one more thing I wanted to bring up while we were alone."

259.speaker: Lucita Azaro
259.text: "Especially given the level of scrutiny he is currently under from Wehlen."

260.speaker: Lucita Azaro
260.text: "Especially while he's the subject of an investigation that, again, was commissioned without the involvement of my department."

261.speaker: Lucita Azaro
261.text: "All the more reason to keep the balance as it is, rather than put more power in your cousin's hands."

262.speaker: Lucita Azaro
262.text: "I beg your pardon, Your Majesty, but Rizia's internal security *is* my business."

263.speaker: Lucita Azaro
263.text: "I do. But putting more power in your cousin's hands sets a dangerous precedent."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "I will extend you my trust when you have earned it. That time has not yet come."

268.speaker: Narrator
268.text: We had come to a small grassy patch in the shade of the fortress' southern wall. Lucita gestured for me to sit down.

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: Suddenly, we heard the click of a camera shutter. A news photographer had managed to get a photo of us from the opposite parapet.

270.speaker: Narrator
270.text: From below, a camera clicked. A news photographer had managed to reach the base of the fortress and capture a picture of us.

271.speaker: Lucita Azaro
271.text: "You are to find this photographer and prevent the publication of this picture at all costs."

272.speaker: Narrator
272.text: Her head disappeared back over the wall. Lucita hurriedly pushed away from me, brushed herself off and turned to the guards surrounding us.

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "Do not berate our staff, Duchess Azaro. But yes, I don't want this photograph getting out."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "You heard her. I'm embarrassed at this obvious security lapse. You ought to be ashamed of yourselves."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "Disregard that order, gentlemen. Let the papers do what they will."

276.speaker: Narrator
276.text: The guards nodded. One of them sprinted off in the direction of the photographer.

278.speaker: Lucita Azaro
278.text: "Really? I thought you wouldn't want the public to think anything was happening between us."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "And why not? You yourself said our houses should be more harmonious."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "That's beside the point. I'm not going to participate in censorship of the press."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "Being seen with my arms around a gorgeous noblewoman will only benefit my reputation, wouldn't you agree?"

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "I don't care what the public thinks. The King of Rizia is above such concerns."

286.speaker: Narrator
286.text: She gave me a coy smile.

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: The smile was still on her face as we left the fortress.

292.speaker: Narrator
292.text: She had a small smile on her face as we left the fortress.

295.speaker: Lucita Azaro
295.text: "We shouldn't fear an uprising, but we should be prepared for one regardless."

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "Arcasia's power is laughable compared to the combined might of the international workers' movement."

300.speaker: Lucita Azaro
300.text: "I... don't know what to say to that. Except that they both pose a threat."

307.speaker: Lucita Azaro
307.text: "My department has the funding already. It wouldn't eat into our budget."

308.speaker: Lucita Azaro
308.text: "I wouldn't even need extra funding. Your expansion of the Golden Guard has created a few redundancies in our intelligence division."

312.speaker: Lucita Azaro
312.text: "It'd just take a small amount of funding."

316.speaker: Narrator
316.text: Her eyes softened as they met mine.

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: She quickly pushed away from me and brushed herself off.

322.speaker: Narrator
322.text: She hurriedly pushed me away and brushed herself off.

323.speaker: Narrator
323.text: Her eyes softened as they met mine.

326.speaker: Narrator
326.text: She gave me a coy smile.

328.speaker: Player_Romus
328.text: "That was close. Wouldn't want anyone to think anything untoward was happening between us."

330.speaker: Narrator
330.text: She gave me a coy smile.

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "Honestly. What do we even pay the Golden Guard for?"

334.speaker: Lucita Azaro
334.text: "You said it, Your Majesty. I didn't."

335.speaker: Narrator
335.text: She had a small smile on her face as we left the fortress.

337.speaker: Lucita Azaro
337.text: "Is that so surprising? Everyone wants something from the King of Rizia."

338.speaker: Lucita Azaro
338.text: "All I am requesting is a chance to speak to you without the stultifying formality of the council."

343.speaker: Narrator
343.text: Lucita bit her lip. She seemed uncharacteristically nervous.

344.speaker: Narrator
344.text: She was smiling, but I registered slight disappointment in her eyes.

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "It's precisely your willingness to speak your mind that makes you such a valuable asset on my council."

347.speaker: Lucita Azaro
347.text: "No, no. That would be unfair to the others."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "I'd like to get to know you better. Tell me about yourself."

350.speaker: Narrator
350.text: She stared out at the surrounding mountains before turning back to me.

351.speaker: Lucita Azaro
351.text: "So. On the subject of speaking my mind."

353.speaker: Narrator
353.text: She seemed to be searching for words.

354.speaker: Lucita Azaro
354.text: "That depends, Your Majesty. What would you like to know?"

356.speaker: Lucita Azaro
356.text: "My sincerest apologies, Your Majesty. I didn't mean to bother you."

357.speaker: Narrator
357.text: Before she could stop herself, she let out an exasperated sigh. She tried to camouflage it as a cough.

365.speaker: Lucita Azaro
365.text: "I thought your granting extra funding to my department was an indication of your trust in me."

372.speaker: Player_Romus
372.text: "While we're at it, is there anything you want to know about me?"

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "It has. Now, what did you want to say to me?"

374.speaker: Lucita Azaro
374.text: "While we're here, though... there *is* something you should know."

376.speaker: Narrator
376.text: She looked me in the eye.

377.speaker: Lucita Azaro
377.text: "Turnabout is fair play, Your Majesty. Why aren't *you* married?"

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "I'm terrified at the idea of loving someone that much again, only to lose them."

379.speaker: Player_Romus
379.text: "I was already in one loveless marriage. I'm not about to enter another."

383.speaker: Player_Romus
383.text: "That is a highly inappropriate question. I refuse to answer."

384.speaker: Player_Romus
384.text: "Romance isn't easy as a royal. You can never tell who truly loves you and who's just grasping for wealth and power."

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "I'm still looking for a woman who can handle me."

386.speaker: Lucita Azaro
386.text: "I understand completely. That's why it's safest for us nobles to marry amongst each other."

387.speaker: Lucita Azaro
387.text: "What makes you think it would be loveless?"

388.speaker: Lucita Azaro
388.text: "Falling in love is like heading into battle. You've got to know what you're up against, and protect yourself accordingly."

389.speaker: Lucita Azaro
389.text: "Ha. All men think they're hard to handle, until they turn into putty at the sight of a nice pair of--"

394.speaker: Lucita Azaro
394.text: "I may as well get to my point."

396.speaker: Player_Romus
396.text: "I know that now. Next time, I'll be better protected."

399.speaker: Narrator
399.text: She and I looked at each other for a long moment.

401.speaker: Lucita Azaro
401.text: "I suppose your turning down my request for funding should have been an indication that you didn't trust me."

402.speaker: Player_Romus
402.text: "It was a gesture of good faith. I will trust you when you get results."

403.speaker: Player_Romus
403.text: "I trust your capabilities. I'm still deciding whether I trust you, personally."

404.speaker: Player_Romus
404.text: "I was only being pragmatic, Duchess. Zille was bombed. Of course we had to investigate."

405.speaker: Player_Romus
405.text: "That had nothing to do with trust. I didn't want to provoke Wehlen so close to the handover deadline."

406.speaker: Lucita Azaro
406.text: "Well... maybe this will help change your mind."

407.speaker: Narrator
407.text: We had come to a small grassy patch in the shade of the fortress' southern wall. Lucita gestured for me to sit down.

409.speaker: Lucita Azaro
409.text: "You had other options, and you went with me. I'd like to think that means something."

411.speaker: Lucita Azaro
411.text: "In the meantime... there's something else I wanted to tell you."

413.speaker: Player_Romus
413.text: "Enough of this, Duchess. You are on my council to provide guidance, not complaints."

415.speaker: Lucita Azaro
415.text: "On the subject of guidance... there is something you should know."

416.speaker: Lucita Azaro
416.text: "Respectfully, Wehlen doesn't seem to have any intention of meeting that deadline. They could do with a little provocation."

420.speaker: Player_Romus
420.text: "Don't take it personally. Titus made a better case."

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "Don't take it personally. I thought both the proposed investigations were a waste of time and money."

422.speaker: Lucita Azaro
422.text: "May I remind you that the deadline for the Zille handover has almost passed? Perhaps at least one investigation could have sped up that process."

423.speaker: Lucita Azaro
423.text: "Right. The man whose only qualification is his ability to take a punch."

424.speaker: Narrator
424.text: She folded her arms and didn't speak for a while. We kept walking.

425.speaker: Lucita Azaro
425.text: "While we are here... there is something you should know."

426.speaker: Lucita Azaro
426.text: "Regardless, though... there's something you should know."

427.speaker: Lucita Azaro
427.text: "Wehlen aside... there is something you should know."

428.speaker: Lucita Azaro
428.text: "The Golden Guard aside... there is something you should know."

429.speaker: Lucita Azaro
429.text: "But Zille aside... there is something you should know."

430.speaker: Lucita Azaro
430.text: "When I took over my father's position on the Royal Council, he gave me a trove of his old files."

431.speaker: Lucita Azaro
431.text: "Wedged between standard purchase orders and internal security reports, I found this."

432.speaker: Narrator
432.text: She reached into her pocket and unfolded a thin square of paper.

433.speaker: Narrator
433.text: On it was a map of Pales. Overlaying the outline of the Grand Duchy were arrows, diagrams of tanks and battalions, and hastily scribbled instructions. Some of them were in my father's handwriting.

435.speaker: Player_Romus
435.text: "So they were plotting another attempt on Pales. That's not surprising."

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "This would never have worked. Not with the military still weakened from the 1920s."

441.speaker: Player_Romus
441.text: "Pathetic. The work of two sad, deluded old men."

442.speaker: Player_Romus
442.text: "Intriguing. Why didn't my father tell me about this?"

443.speaker: Lucita Azaro
443.text: "Had this been attempted, it would have been a complete rout."

444.speaker: Lucita Azaro
444.text: "All glory to King Valero, but perhaps it's fortunate that he died before this could be carried out."

446.speaker: Lucita Azaro
446.text: "It's a plan to reconquer Pales. One that would have been futile, at least with the military of the time."

447.speaker: Lucita Azaro
447.text: "Some of these instructions are actually genius. But it would have been futile with the military of the time."

451.speaker: Lucita Azaro
451.text: "He thought you'd inform Duke Reinhart, I assume."

452.speaker: Lucita Azaro
452.text: "It was still a work in progress when he died, I assume."

453.speaker: Lucita Azaro
453.text: "This plan would have ended in a complete rout. At least with the military of the time."

454.speaker: Player_Romus
454.text: "How dare you even imply that my father's death was a fortunate occurrence? I should have you skinned alive."

458.speaker: Player_Romus
458.text: "Is it possible that whoever murdered him knew about this plan?"

459.speaker: Player_Romus
459.text: "It pains me to say so, but yes. Better that he died rather than order more soldiers to their deaths."

461.speaker: Player_Romus
461.text: "Maybe he didn't intend to carry it out. Maybe he wanted me to do it."

462.speaker: Lucita Azaro
462.text: "If he was murdered, that could have served as a motivation, yes."

464.speaker: Lucita Azaro
464.text: "Or the plan was scrapped when they realized it would never work."

465.speaker: Lucita Azaro
465.text: "If he was murdered as you suspect... that could be a motivation."

469.speaker: Lucita Azaro
469.text: "Then again, it's possible they never intended to execute this plan. It could've just been idle daydreaming."

470.speaker: Lucita Azaro
470.text: "I -- I'm so sorry. I never meant to imply that."

471.speaker: Lucita Azaro
471.text: "Perhaps he never even intended to execute this, anyway."

472.speaker: Player_Romus
472.text: "His dying wish was for me to take back the lands that were lost. I can't fail him."

473.speaker: Player_Romus
473.text: "I don't understand why this even exists, though. Why does Rizia need to reconquer Pales?"

477.speaker: Player_Romus
477.text: "The plan doesn't even make sense. I supported the Reclamation War, but... now? After all these years?"

478.speaker: Player_Romus
478.text: "I understand why they drew this up, though. I too never gave up on reconquering Pales."

479.speaker: Player_Romus
479.text: "The timing wasn't right to reconquer Pales in the '20s. But perhaps now..."

483.speaker: Player_Romus
483.text: "His dying wish was for me to take back the lands that were lost. But I'm no conqueror."

486.speaker: Lucita Azaro
486.text: "Of course, my family would disagree. My province never got over losing our access to the sea."

487.speaker: Lucita Azaro
487.text: "You and most of my province. The Azaros never got over losing their access to the sea."

488.speaker: Lucita Azaro
488.text: "It's an outdated concept. Invading territories based on centuries-old grudges."

490.speaker: Lucita Azaro
490.text: "But I don't see any merit in taking back Pales. At least, not for historic reasons."

491.speaker: Player_Romus
491.text: "Are you saying there are other reasons?"

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "I trust your guidance, Duchess. If there's a reason you think we should go to war with Pales again, I want to know."

493.speaker: Lucita Azaro
493.text: "My family is with you, of course. The Azaros never got over losing their access to the sea."

494.speaker: Lucita Azaro
494.text: "My family would be with you, of course. The Azaros never got over losing their access to the sea."

495.speaker: Player_Romus
495.text: "You're lying. You're as thirsty for revenge as the rest of your family."

498.speaker: Lucita Azaro
498.text: "I'm a realist, Your Majesty. Revenge has no place in my worldview."

500.speaker: Lucita Azaro
500.text: "But with Lespia in ATO, and Morella becoming closer to Valgsland and the CSP... I do wonder whether our neighbor will get swallowed up in the superpower conflict."

501.speaker: Lucita Azaro
501.text: "With Lespia in ATO, and Morella becoming closer to Valgsland and the CSP, I do wonder whether our neighbor will get swallowed up in the superpower conflict."

502.speaker: Player_Romus
502.text: "That's ridiculous. It's an inconsequential little strip of land."

503.speaker: Player_Romus
503.text: "I'm not sure what you're getting at."

505.speaker: Lucita Azaro
505.text: "Look at what happened to Wehlen in the 1930s. Arcasia and United Contana nearly destroyed it by proxy in a rush to gain access to its oil."

506.speaker: Lucita Azaro
506.text: "And now Pales may be sitting on an even more valuable resource..."

507.speaker: Player_Romus
507.text: "Lespia's involvement with Pales is clear. But we haven't seen any signs that the CSP has designs on it."

508.speaker: Player_Romus
508.text: "So you think we should conquer Pales for its own good."

509.speaker: Player_Romus
509.text: "You're my security councilor, Duchess. I don't want you concerning yourself with geopolitics."

510.speaker: Player_Romus
510.text: "I'm glad that you're the one who wound up on my council, not your hawk of a father."

512.speaker: Lucita Azaro
512.text: "My father belongs to a different generation. One that solves disputes with brute force, not subtlety."

513.speaker: Lucita Azaro
513.text: "I must admit that I harbor concerns about Pales as well, though."

515.speaker: Lucita Azaro
515.text: "This is a security issue, Your Majesty."

516.speaker: Lucita Azaro
516.text: "Not yet. But with Morella edging closer to Valgsland, they might be emboldened to try for a reconquest of their own."

517.speaker: Lucita Azaro
517.text: "Think of it as a chess game. Sometimes it's best to remove certain pieces from the board before it's too late."

519.speaker: Lucita Azaro
519.text: "At least part of it belongs to Pales. The researchers have determined that much."

521.speaker: Lucita Azaro
521.text: "The Wehlen Civil War happened before the development of nuclear weapons, Your Majesty. Today's superpower conflicts have the potential for far more wide-ranging damage."

522.speaker: Lucita Azaro
522.text: "That doesn't mean I think we should attack Pales again. Using diplomacy to get them on our side would be a more effective tactic."

523.speaker: Player_Romus
523.text: "I know that. I've been aiming for diplomacy this entire time."

527.speaker: Player_Romus
527.text: "My war councilor is urging me to practice diplomacy. Now I've heard everything."

528.speaker: Lucita Azaro
528.text: "War should be a last resort, Your Majesty. Contrary to what your or my father would say."

529.speaker: Lucita Azaro
529.text: "If we get into a dispute over the new gas field, it may be more difficult to stay the course."

530.speaker: Player_Romus
530.text: "Diplomatic attempts will only get us so far. At some point, force may be needed."

531.speaker: Lucita Azaro
531.text: "You may be right. But we should not be the first to initiate aggression."

532.speaker: Player_Romus
532.text: "I disagree. You've just given me one more reason why retaking Pales is the best course of action."

533.speaker: Lucita Azaro
533.text: "I would not presume to contradict you, Your Majesty. But I urge caution."

534.speaker: Player_Romus
534.text: "No, you're right. Beautiful women are a weakness of mine."

536.speaker: Player_Romus
536.text: "That's not how it works. You can't fall in love if you're holding a part of yourself back."

537.speaker: Player_Romus
537.text: "I don't much care for discussions about love. What are your feelings on the Galmish Manifesto?"

540.speaker: Lucita Azaro
540.text: "Giving all of yourself to a lover allows them to have absolute power over you. I refuse to subjugate myself to anyone."

541.speaker: Lucita Azaro
541.text: "Tell the Golden Guard to form a cordon around your heart."

542.speaker: Narrator
542.text: She laughed softly at her own joke.

543.speaker: Narrator
543.text: The corner of her mouth twitched.

546.speaker: Lucita Azaro
546.text: "It seeks to replace the sanctity of order and hierarchy with empty egalitarian illusions. Their leader Halvorsdatir won't hold out till the end of her term."

548.speaker: Player_Romus
548.text: "Marriages between royals are political arrangements. Love seldom has anything to do with it."

549.speaker: Player_Romus
549.text: "I've never loved a woman up till now. I just don't see it happening."

550.speaker: Lucita Azaro
550.text: "It's never too late, though, is it?"

551.speaker: Lucita Azaro
551.text: "You never know, Your Majesty. You might get lucky."

554.speaker: Lucita Azaro
554.text: "But we'd better move on to what I wanted to say."

555.speaker: Lucita Azaro
555.text: "I should move on to what I wanted to say."

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "Actually, I find intelligence far more attractive than physical attributes."

559.speaker: Lucita Azaro
559.text: "Then you'd better remarry quickly, before one takes advantage of you."

562.speaker: Player_Romus
562.text: "Far from it, Duchess. You still remain an inscrutable mystery to me."

565.speaker: Lucita Azaro
565.text: "Fear not, Your Majesty. You'll have plenty of chances to learn more."

566.speaker: Lucita Azaro
566.text: "If you wanted me to, I could send a task force to Pales to monitor the situation more closely."

567.speaker: Player_Romus
567.text: "Thank you for the suggestion. But I'm afraid such an action will be misinterpreted as aggression."

568.speaker: Player_Romus
568.text: "That sounds wise. Do what you need to do." [-1 Budget]

569.speaker: Player_Romus
569.text: "No. I want all our intelligence capabilities concentrated on the Zille incident at the moment."

570.speaker: Lucita Azaro
570.text: "The idea would be to avoid aggression. But I understand."

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "I respectfully refuse. Our internal security is a lot more pressing right now."

573.speaker: Lucita Azaro
573.text: "I understand. We'll focus on that going forward."

574.speaker: Player_Romus
574.text: "That sounds wise. Do what you need to do."

575.speaker: Lucita Azaro
575.text: "I understand. We'll focus on that going forward."

579.speaker: Player_Romus
579.text: "I appreciate you coming to me with all this. Please feel free to express your unfettered opinions to me in the future."

580.speaker: Player_Romus
580.text: "May I keep that map of Pales?"

582.speaker: Narrator
582.text: She handed me the piece of paper. I took a last look at it.

588.speaker: Player_Romus
588.text: "Thank you for showing me this. But I must insist you bring up such issues at council meetings in the future. I don't want anyone getting the wrong idea."

589.speaker: Player_Romus
589.text: "Feel free to throw that map away. It's of no use to me."

590.speaker: Player_Romus
590.text: "I will do everything in my power to prevent conflict with Pales. But just in case..."

591.speaker: Player_Romus
591.text: "I will finish what our fathers started. Even if it takes my entire reign."

592.speaker: Player_Romus
592.text: "I will keep this as a reminder of Valero the Frail's folly."

593.speaker: Lucita Azaro
593.text: "If it does come to that, you'll need a better strategy. Or a better army."

594.speaker: Lucita Azaro
594.text: "If you insist on taking that path, you'll have my family's aid. As well as mine."

598.speaker: Lucita Azaro
598.text: "Certainly, Your Majesty. I wouldn't presume to demand special treatment."

599.speaker: Lucita Azaro
599.text: "Agreed, Your Majesty. It's a relic of a more reckless age."

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "Why didn't the guards step in? I should have them disciplined at once."

602.speaker: Player_Romus
602.text: "Forgive me. I wasn't fast enough to help you."

604.speaker: Lucita Azaro
604.text: "I wasn't expecting your assistance, Your Majesty."

606.speaker: Lucita Azaro
606.text: "God has nothing to do with it."

607.speaker: Lucita Azaro
607.text: "There's only one person I rely on for protection. Me."

608.speaker: Lucita Azaro
608.text: "I wasn't expecting their assistance, Your Majesty."

609.speaker: Player_Romus
609.text: "That was the purpose of the uprising. To show us that our blood doesn't make us special."

610.speaker: Lucita Azaro
610.text: "I joined the military so I'd never get caught by surprise like that again."

612.speaker: Lucita Azaro
612.text: "All it showed me was that I had to be prepared to defend myself at a moment's notice."

621.speaker: Player_Romus
621.text: "I'll make sure you'll get what the help you need without the extra funds. Do what you need to do." [-2 Authority]

623.speaker: Player_Romus
623.text: "Sorry but we don't have extra funds to spare."

633.speaker: Lucita Azaro
633.text: "And considering the provincial leaders no longer command their own police forces... it seems to me like you're granting Ricardus a special favor."

634.speaker: Lucita Azaro
634.text: "As long as the provincial police system exists, Iza should be receiving help from Brenas."

636.speaker: Player_Romus
636.text: "You can send more police to Cardesse-Montaklar if you like. I won't stop you."

638.speaker: Player_Romus
638.text: "Brenas won't help him. House Sazon is practically laughing in his face."

639.speaker: Lucita Azaro
639.text: "Then we ought to force them into line."

640.speaker: Player_Romus
640.text: "Just give Rico some time. If he can't get Iza under control with these extra reinforcements, I'll take them away again."

646.speaker: Lucita Azaro
646.text: "I am curious why you decided to remove the provincial levy system."

647.speaker: Player_Romus
647.text: "I thought you'd be pleased with this decision. A completely centralized military means more troops under your direct command."

648.speaker: Lucita Azaro
648.text: "Do you have reason to believe the royal houses should not be entrusted with their own armies?"

649.speaker: Player_Romus
649.text: "I believe certain houses can be trusted and certain others can't. But it would have raised too much suspicion to remove the levies in only one province."

650.speaker: Player_Romus
650.text: "Sorry, but the provincial armies were a potential threat to my power as King. They had to go."

653.speaker: Player_Romus
653.text: "That is strictly confidential. I'd rather not discuss it with you."

654.speaker: Lucita Azaro
654.text: "I'm sorry you felt that way. I know your father considered the Azaro special forces among his most valuable military assets."

656.speaker: Lucita Azaro
656.text: "As a councilor, I'm honored. As the Duchess of this province, I am skeptical."

658.speaker: Lucita Azaro
658.text: "You'd rather not discuss significant security matters... with your security councilor. I see."

659.speaker: Lucita Azaro
659.text: "Well, perhaps you're willing to discuss this."

660.speaker: Lucita Azaro
660.text: "I must tell you House Azaro wasn't happy with this directive."

661.speaker: Lucita Azaro
661.text: "The Azaro army had a long, proud tradition of defending Rizia and its monarch. Their skill and dedication were unlike anything else in this kingdom."

662.speaker: Player_Romus
662.text: "And they will be just as skillfull and dedicated serving directly under the Crown. Won't they?"

663.speaker: Player_Romus
663.text: "Exactly. If such a formidable force ever were to turn against their King, the consequences would be catastrophic."

664.speaker: Player_Romus
664.text: "That's the problem. Your house was making the rest of army look weak by comparison. Such greatness needs to be dispersed through the entire Armed Forces, not concentrated in one province."

667.speaker: Lucita Azaro
667.text: "I'm disappointed you think that would even be a possibility, Your Majesty. Your father considered the Azaro special forces among his most valuable military assets."

669.speaker: Lucita Azaro
669.text: "But you are not King Valero. I understand."

671.speaker: Player_Romus
671.text: "Yes, and I am truly sad to see it go. But greater things are on the horizon for Rizia's armies. You'll see."

673.speaker: Lucita Azaro
673.text: "That's very kind of you. I'll try to convey that reasoning to my relatives."

674.speaker: Lucita Azaro
674.text: "And I hope you believe me when I say the Azaros will never pose a threat to you."

676.speaker: Lucita Azaro
676.text: "Whatever you have in store, I hope I'll be the first to know."

677.speaker: Lucita Azaro
677.text: "I will not question you any further about this. But there's something else that's been bothering me..."

682.speaker: Player_Romus
682.text: "Of course. But while we're on the subject... isn't there anything you'd like to know about me?"
